lead: Five timed sections, about 20 minutes: reasoning, memory, speed and spatial skills, then Pokémon knowledge. Scored against other trainers; not a clinical IQ test.
currentCognitive: Your Cognitive PokéIQ: {score} ({p, selectordinal, one {{p}st} two {{p}nd} few {{p}rd} other {{p}th}} percentile).

fluid.title: Fluid reasoning
fluid.intro: Find the hidden rule and pick the missing piece.

memory.title: Working memory
memory.intro: Hold a sequence or a sum in your head, then answer.

speed.title: Processing speed
speed.intro: 75 seconds: tap every match as fast as you can.

spatial.title: Spatial
spatial.intro: Turn, route and count things in your mind's eye.

knowledge.title: Pokémon knowledge
knowledge.intro: 20 adaptive questions on the Pokémon themselves.

matrix: The 3 by 3 pattern, last cell missing
rotation: Which one is this {name} turned — not mirrored?
path: Fewest steps from the Poké Ball to the Gym (up, down, left, right; trees block)?
pile: How many Poké Balls in the pile, the hidden ones included? Every ball rests on balls below it.

arith.l1: {name} has {max} HP and takes {dmg} damage. How much HP is left?
arith.l2: {name} has {max} HP, takes {dmg} damage, then heals {heal}. HP now?
arith.l3: {name} has {max} HP. It takes {dmg}, heals {heal}, then takes {dmg2}. HP now?
arith.l4: {name} has {max} max HP, takes {dmg} damage, then eats a Sitrus Berry (restores ¼ of max HP). HP now?
arith.l5: {name} has {max} max HP. It is hit twice for {hit}, uses Rest (restores ½ of max HP), then takes {extra} more. HP now?
